narrative.benchmark_md:
Four peers were selected in Research Batch 1 (April 15, 2026) and locked as immutable for the duration of this assessment: Rocket Mortgage (mega IMB, NYSE-listed [E-011, T2], direct-to-consumer digital leader with mello AI platform), loanDepot (large IMB, public SEC filings (LDI), materially impacted by January 2024 ransomware attack [E-013, T2]), CrossCountry Mortgage (large IMB, similar LO-branch distribution model, limited public tech disclosure [E-012, T3]), and Fairway Independent Mortgage (large IMB, conservative technology adoption, ~$18–20B volume [E-014, T3]). Peers were scored at category level using public evidence and rated against the same 17-category framework. Peer medians represent the arithmetic median score across the four peers for each category. Rate's financial recovery trajectory — from ~$16–18B in 2023 to $24.7B in 2024 (HMDA [E-015, T1]) to $20.2B in H1 2025 (+14% YoY, [E-143, T2]) — was used to contextualise scoring within a market recovery macro-environment.
Acknowledgement of limitations: This assessment was conducted exclusively using public evidence sources. The 371 capability without direct public evidence are scored at 1.5 (evidence floor), materially constraining P1 (41.8% covered) and P2 (32.8% covered). Digital innovation signals — including the 2018 FlashClose HW Tech100 award [E-034, T2], 2020 AI Foundry acquisition [E-082, T2], 2024 Rate Intelligence launch [E-040, T2], and Prajna AI ICML 2025 presentation [E-128, T3] — confirm a rich 8-year technology innovation arc that public evidence can only partially capture. Internal evidence collected through discovery sessions (recommended internal evidence request in Section 11) is expected to raise the overall score to approximately 2.7–2.9 (level 3 Developing). Rate's Same Day Mortgage and NPS 9.7/10 metrics [E-054, E-055, T2] are representative of the evidence available for high-visibility public-facing capabilities, whereas internal processes (model governance, data architecture, board governance) require internal documentation to score above evidence ceilings.
